title: The Mega Powers explode
summary: Hulk Hogan rescues Randy Savage in October 1987, beginning an alliance that carries Savage to the WWF championship. With Miss Elizabeth at their side, the Mega Powers overcome the Mega Bucks before Savage’s jealousy over Hogan’s attention to Elizabeth and his title tears the team apart. Their roughly 18-month rise and collapse pays off in a championship showdown at WrestleMania V.

chapters.title: The rescue that forms the Mega Powers
chapters.result: Savage defeats The Honky Tonk Man by disqualification; Honky retains the Intercontinental championship.
chapters.context: The Honky Tonk Man and the Hart Foundation attack Savage, prompting Miss Elizabeth to fetch Hulk Hogan. Hogan clears the ring, and the former rivals seal their alliance with a handshake. Their celebration and interview introduce the Mega Powers, combining Hulkamania with Macho Madness. October 3 is the television air date.

chapters.title: Hogan helps Savage reach the summit
chapters.result: Savage defeats Ted DiBiase in the tournament final to win his first WWF championship.
chapters.context: Savage reaches the final after three earlier matches, but André the Giant is in DiBiase’s corner. With André distracting the referee and DiBiase applying the Million Dollar Dream, Hogan strikes DiBiase with a chair. Savage follows with his diving elbow drop for the pin, then celebrates with Hogan and Elizabeth. The championship becomes the symbol of their alliance’s success—and later a focus of Savage’s suspicions.

chapters.title: The Mega Powers conquer the Mega Bucks
chapters.result: Hogan and Savage defeat André the Giant and Ted DiBiase in the inaugural SummerSlam main event.
chapters.context: With Jesse Ventura as guest referee and the Mega Powers in trouble, Elizabeth climbs onto the apron and removes her skirt to distract the Mega Bucks. Hogan and Savage recover: Savage lands his elbow drop on DiBiase, and Hogan follows with the leg drop for the victory. Elizabeth’s intervention makes her central to the team’s biggest win together.

chapters.title: Victory gives way to visible tension
chapters.result: Hogan and Savage are the two survivors of their five-on-five elimination match.
chapters.context: The Mega Powers’ team overcomes opposition led by the Twin Towers and Ted DiBiase, with Hogan pinning Haku to finish the match. During the celebration, Hogan lifts Elizabeth into his arms while Savage watches unhappily. Their success as partners now sits alongside a growing on-screen jealousy: gestures Hogan treats as friendly increasingly look threatening to Savage.

chapters.title: A Royal Rumble mistake strains the alliance
chapters.result: Hogan accidentally eliminates his partner Savage from the Royal Rumble match.
chapters.context: As Hogan tries to send Bad News Brown over the top rope, Savage goes out too. An angry Savage returns to confront Hogan, turning the every-man-for-himself match into another test of their friendship. Elizabeth intervenes and calms the confrontation, preserving the alliance for the moment without resolving the mistrust.

chapters.title: The Mega Powers break apart
chapters.result: Savage abandons Hogan against the Twin Towers, then attacks him backstage with the championship belt.
chapters.context: During the match against Akeem and Big Boss Man, Savage tumbles into Elizabeth at ringside, leaving her apparently unconscious in the storyline. Hogan carries her backstage for medical attention, leaving Savage to fight alone. When Hogan returns, Savage slaps him and walks out; Hogan still wins the match. Backstage, Savage accuses his partner of coveting both Elizabeth and the WWF title, then strikes him with the belt. The simmering jealousy becomes an outright betrayal and a heel turn.

chapters.title: The Mega Powers explode at WrestleMania
chapters.result: Hogan defeats Savage to win his second WWF championship, ending Savage’s year-long reign.
chapters.context: Elizabeth begins in a neutral corner as the former allies fight for the championship Hogan helped Savage win a year earlier. Savage lands his flying elbow, but Hogan kicks out, rallies, and finishes with the big boot and leg drop. WrestleMania V delivers the title-match payoff to the alliance’s collapse; their rivalry continues beyond this chapter.
